name: Pickaway County, OH
findings: Pickaway County has 172 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pickaway County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
